papers.name: CORE
papers.title: CORE: Reducing UI Exposure in Mobile Agents via Collaboration Between Cloud and Local LLMs
papers.summary: Partitions the XML screen into layout-aware blocks on the phone; the local LLM proposes a sub-task per block, the cloud LLM picks the current sub-task from these candidates, and then the cloud selects the target element only within the blocks the local LLM ranks highest.
papers.summary_zh: 在手机上按 XML 布局把屏幕划成语义块；本地 LLM 为每个块推测一个子任务，云端 LLM 从候选中选定当前子任务，再只在本地 LLM 排名靠前的块中选择目标元素。
papers.exchange: Per-block sub-task candidates, the task and history, and only the top-ranked UI blocks / the selected sub-task and target element
papers.exchange_zh: 各块的候选子任务、任务描述与历史，以及排名靠前的 UI 块 / 选定的子任务与目标元素
papers.evidence: DroidTask (143 tasks, 12 apps) on a real Honor Play3 phone with Android 9 and AndroidLab (98 tasks, 9 apps) on the Pixel 7 Pro emulator; GPT-4o via API is the cloud LLM, while local LLMs such as Gemma 2-9B and Qwen2.5-7B run on an RTX 4090D GPU rather than on the phone; UI exposure reduction and cloud and local latency are reported separately.
papers.evidence_zh: DroidTask（143 个任务、12 个应用）在搭载 Android 9 的真实 Honor Play3 手机上运行，AndroidLab（98 个任务、9 个应用）在 Pixel 7 Pro 模拟器上运行；云端 LLM 为通过 API 调用的 GPT-4o，Gemma 2-9B、Qwen2.5-7B 等本地 LLM 跑在 RTX 4090D GPU 上而非手机上；UI 暴露减少量以及云端、本地延迟分别报告。
papers.code_status: author-linked

papers.name: Available but Invisible
papers.title: Anonymization-Enhanced Privacy Protection for Mobile GUI Agents: Available but Invisible
papers.summary: Places a local mediation layer between the phone and a cloud GUI agent that replaces detected PII in instructions, XML, and screenshots with type-preserving placeholders, executes the agent's actions on the anonymized interface, and runs narrowly scoped local computations when raw values are needed.
papers.summary_zh: 在手机与云端 GUI agent 之间放一层本地中介：把指令、XML 和截图中检测到的 PII 替换为保留类型的占位符，在匿名化界面上代为执行 agent 的动作，需要原始值时只做范围受限的本地计算。
papers.exchange: Anonymized instructions, XML hierarchies, and screenshots with typed placeholders / actions over the virtual UI, resolved locally against real values
papers.exchange_zh: 带类型占位符的匿名化指令、XML 层级和截图 / 针对虚拟界面的动作，由本地对照真实值解析
papers.evidence: AndroidLab (138 tasks, XML and SoM modes) on the default Pixel 7 Pro emulator with GPT-4o and Gemini-3-flash-preview as cloud agents, and PrivScreen QA with Qwen2.5-VL-7B, GPT-5, and UI-TARS-7B; PrivScreen baseline numbers are cited from the DualTAP paper; no on-phone latency or energy measurement.
papers.evidence_zh: AndroidLab（138 个任务，XML 与 SoM 两种模式）在默认 Pixel 7 Pro 模拟器上运行，云端 agent 为 GPT-4o 和 Gemini-3-flash-preview；PrivScreen 问答使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B、GPT-5 和 UI-TARS-7B，其基线数字引自 DualTAP 论文；没有手机上的延迟或能耗测量。
papers.code_status: author-linked

papers.name: GoClick
papers.title: GoClick: Lightweight Element Grounding Model for Autonomous GUI Interaction
papers.summary: A 230M-parameter encoder-decoder GUI grounding model; in its device-cloud agent setting a cloud VLM planner such as GPT-4o outputs an action intent or the target's functional description, and GoClick localizes the element on the device from the same screenshot.
papers.summary_zh: 一个 2.3 亿参数的编码器-解码器 GUI 元素定位模型；在其端云 agent 设定中，云端 VLM 规划器（如 GPT-4o）输出动作意图或目标元素的功能描述，GoClick 在端侧根据同一张截图定位元素。
papers.exchange: Screenshot and task for planning / action intent or functional description of the target element
papers.exchange_zh: 用于规划的截图与任务 / 动作意图或目标元素的功能描述
papers.evidence: Grounding benchmarks plus step-level agent evaluation on recorded screenshot trajectories with ground-truth actions; TTFT and TPOT are measured on one L20 GPU at batch size 1 with a 780×360 input to approximate mobile use, not on a phone.
papers.evidence_zh: 在 GUI 定位基准上评测，并在带标准动作的录制截图轨迹上做逐步 agent 评测；TTFT 与 TPOT 在单张 L20 GPU 上以批大小 1、780×360 输入近似手机场景测得，并非手机实测。
papers.code_status: author-linked

papers.name: MAI-UI
papers.title: MAI-UI Technical Report: Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
papers.summary: A family of GUI agent models whose on-device variant also monitors its own trajectory: when the trajectory deviates and the context holds no privacy-sensitive data, it hands the remaining steps to a cloud agent together with an error summary over a unified on-device trajectory memory.
papers.summary_zh: 一组 GUI agent 模型，其端侧版本同时监控自身轨迹：当轨迹偏离指令且上下文不含隐私敏感数据时，把后续步骤连同错误摘要交给云端 agent，双方共享端侧统一的轨迹记忆。
papers.exchange: Error summary plus trajectory history (instruction, screenshots, past thoughts and actions) at the switch / the cloud agent executes the remaining steps
papers.exchange_zh: 切换时的错误摘要与轨迹历史（指令、截图、此前的思考与动作） / 由云端 agent 执行剩余步骤
papers.evidence: AndroidWorld online evaluation of the device–cloud system against device-only, random-switch, no-error-summary, and cloud-only baselines, reporting success rate, cloud-call reduction, and the share of tasks finished on device; models are Qwen3-VL-based MAI-UI variants from 2B to 235B-A22B; privacy blocking is shown only as a pilot case study, and the checked sections report no phone latency or energy.
papers.evidence_zh: 在 AndroidWorld 上在线评估端云系统，对比纯端侧、随机切换、无错误摘要和纯云端基线，报告成功率、云端调用减少量和完全在端侧完成的任务比例；模型为基于 Qwen3-VL 的 MAI-UI 系列（2B 至 235B-A22B）；隐私拦截只以试点案例展示，所查章节未报告手机延迟或能耗。
papers.code_status: author-linked

papers.name: PAAC
papers.title: PAAC: Privacy-Aware Agentic Device-Cloud Collaboration
papers.summary: Aligns planner–executor roles with the device–cloud trust boundary: the cloud agent plans over typed placeholder tokens, the on-device agent proposes which spans to mask and condenses each step's outcome into key findings, and a deterministic registry substitutes and reverses values so actions stay executable on the device.
papers.summary_zh: 让规划者与执行者的分工对齐端云信任边界：云端 agent 只在带类型的占位符上规划；端侧 agent 提出需要遮挡的片段并把每步结果浓缩为要点；由确定性注册表完成替换与还原，使动作可直接在端侧执行。
papers.exchange: Sanitized task and per-step key findings with typed placeholders / sanitized reasoning and actions that the device de-references before execution
papers.exchange_zh: 带类型占位符的脱敏任务与每步要点 / 脱敏的推理与动作，端侧执行前还原
papers.evidence: τ²-Bench Airline (50) and Retail (115) plus 20 sampled GAIA tasks under privacy levels P0–P3, and 17 further benchmarks with 100 sampled instances each; the on-device agent Qwen3-4B-Instruct is served by vLLM on an NVIDIA A100 and the cloud agent is Gemini 3 Flash; leakage is computed with three LLM evaluators plus regex matching; no phone deployment.
papers.evidence_zh: 在 τ²-Bench Airline（50 例）、Retail（115 例）和抽样的 20 个 GAIA 任务上按 P0–P3 隐私等级评测，另有 17 个基准各抽样 100 例；端侧 agent Qwen3-4B-Instruct 通过 vLLM 跑在 NVIDIA A100 上，云端 agent 为 Gemini 3 Flash；泄露率由三个 LLM 评估器加正则匹配计算；没有手机部署。
papers.code_status: not located in checked paper pages

papers.name: AdecPilot
papers.title: Administrative Decentralization in Edge-Cloud Multi-Agent for Mobile Automation
papers.summary: Gives the cloud only UI-agnostic strategic design in the form of abstract milestones, while a bimodal edge team plans and grounds tactically, self-corrects without cloud intervention, and stops via a hierarchical implicit termination protocol.
papers.summary_zh: 云端只负责与界面无关的战略设计，输出抽象里程碑；端侧双模态 agent 团队负责战术规划与定位、在没有云端介入时自我纠错，并用分层隐式终止协议判断何时停止。
papers.exchange: Task instruction with far fewer UI elements than a cloud-only agent uploads / abstract milestones, with at most one replanning round
papers.exchange_zh: 任务指令，上传的 UI 元素远少于纯云端 agent / 抽象里程碑，至多一轮重规划
papers.evidence: AndroidWorld (116 tasks, 20 apps) on a Pixel 6 emulator (API 33) over three seeds, plus AndroidLab; GPT-4o is the cloud designer and a quantized Qwen3-VL-2B runs on a local server with an RTX 4070 TiS GPU; reports success rate, cloud calls and tokens, relative cloud energy, latency, and reduction in uploaded UI elements.
papers.evidence_zh: AndroidWorld（116 个任务、20 个应用）在 Pixel 6 模拟器（API 33）上跑三个随机种子，另有 AndroidLab；云端设计者为 GPT-4o，量化的 Qwen3-VL-2B 跑在配有 RTX 4070 TiS 的本地服务器上；报告成功率、云端调用与 token、相对云端能耗、延迟和上传 UI 元素的减少量。
papers.code_status: not located in checked paper pages

papers.name: SPECTRA
papers.title: SPECTRA: On-Device Cognitive Perturbation and Trajectory Analysis for Autonomous Edge-Cloud GUI Grounding
papers.summary: Decides when an edge GUI-grounding agent should ask the cloud by masking salient visual anchors and measuring how far the edge model's prefill-stage hidden-state trajectories drift, so the request decision needs no autoregressive decoding.
papers.summary_zh: 通过遮挡关键视觉锚点、测量端侧模型 prefill 阶段隐藏状态轨迹的漂移程度，判断端侧 GUI 定位 agent 是否需要请求云端，请求决策无需自回归解码。
papers.exchange: Screenshot and instruction for requested cases / cloud grounding coordinates
papers.exchange_zh: 被判定需要请求的截图与指令 / 云端给出的定位坐标
papers.evidence: MMBench-GUI, ScreenSpot-Pro, and UI-I2E-Bench with InfiGUI-G1-3B or Holo1.5-3B on the edge and GTA1-32B in the cloud; request quality is reported as AUC, SRCC, and the area under a normalized collaborative-gain curve over request rates, and an on-device cost table is given for InfiGUI-G1-3B on ScreenSpot-Pro.
papers.evidence_zh: 在 MMBench-GUI、ScreenSpot-Pro 和 UI-I2E-Bench 上评测，端侧为 InfiGUI-G1-3B 或 Holo1.5-3B，云端为 GTA1-32B；请求质量以 AUC、SRCC 和归一化协同增益曲线下面积报告，并给出 InfiGUI-G1-3B 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上的端侧开销表。
papers.code_status: not located in checked paper pages

papers.name: PrivacyGuard
papers.title: PrivacyGuard: Source-Linked Sanitization and Locally Resolvable PII References for Cloud GUI Agents
papers.summary: A device-resident mediation path for cloud GUI agents that rewrites the full source extent of fragmented or changed PII in instructions and screenshots and replaces it with session-scoped structured references, which the planner can use and the device resolves locally before execution.
papers.summary_zh: 云端 GUI agent 的端侧中介：对指令和截图中碎片化或形式变化的 PII 按完整来源范围改写，替换为会话级结构化引用；规划器可以使用这些引用，端侧在执行前于本地解析回真实值。
papers.exchange: Sanitized instructions and screenshots carrying structured entity references / actions whose references are resolved locally
papers.exchange_zh: 带结构化实体引用的脱敏指令与截图 / 含引用的动作，在本地解析
papers.evidence: Five-turn CrossTurnPII sessions, reference-required Android tasks, AndroidLab (138 tasks, four planners), and PrivScreen; all compared protection pipelines run on the same RTX 4090 server, which the authors describe as experimental apparatus rather than the remote planner, and a Xiaomi 12S workload checks single-device prototype feasibility.
papers.evidence_zh: 在五轮 CrossTurnPII 会话、需要引用的 Android 任务、AndroidLab（138 个任务、四个规划器）和 PrivScreen 上评测；所有对比的保护流程都跑在同一台 RTX 4090 服务器上，作者说明它是实验设备而非远端规划器；另用 Xiaomi 12S 上的负载验证单机原型的可行性。
papers.code_status: author-linked

papers.name: On-Device Operation Caches
papers.title: On Device Agentic Operation Caches -- Classifier-Centric NL-to-Action Generation
papers.summary: Turns frequent natural-language-to-action requests into classification over cached operation idioms with a small fine-tuned on-device model, executing confident cache hits locally and passing low-confidence queries to a cloud model.
papers.summary_zh: 把高频的自然语言到操作请求转成对缓存操作模板的分类，由端侧微调的小模型完成；置信度高的命中在本地执行，低置信度请求交给云端模型。
papers.exchange: Low-confidence queries with their table context / generated formula
papers.exchange_zh: 低置信度的查询及其表格上下文 / 生成的公式
papers.evidence: NL2Formula (70,799 query–formula pairs over 21,670 tables) with a target 60% hit rate and at least 95% precision; Gemma 3 1B serves as the cache model and GPT-5 with model routing is the cloud-only baseline; the device hardware behind the latency figures is not described in the checked sections.
papers.evidence_zh: 在 NL2Formula（21,670 张表上的 70,799 对查询与公式）上评测，目标命中率 60%、精度不低于 95%；缓存模型为 Gemma 3 1B，纯云端基线为带模型路由的 GPT-5；所查章节未说明延迟数字对应的设备硬件。
papers.code_status: not located in checked paper pages

papers.name: PriCon
papers.title: Ask Without Telling: Local SLMs Consult Cloud LLMs Without Revealing Task Intent
papers.summary: Hides task intent, not only sensitive values, when a local SLM consults a cloud LLM: the SLM rewrites the task into a recoverable mathematical form, optionally re-dressed as a semantic surrogate from another domain, and maps the cloud's guidance or code back to the original task locally.
papers.summary_zh: 在本地 SLM 咨询云端 LLM 时隐藏任务意图，而不只是敏感数值：SLM 把任务改写成可还原的数学形式，必要时再包装成另一领域的语义替身，云端返回的指导或代码由本地映射回原任务。
papers.exchange: Mathematical reformulation or cross-domain semantic surrogate of the task / guidance or code for the surrogate, mapped back locally
papers.exchange_zh: 任务的数学改写或跨领域语义替身 / 针对替身任务的指导或代码，由本地映射回原任务
papers.evidence: Read from the PDF because the HTML rendering is truncated; the local-SLM role is played by GPT-4o-mini, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and a Qwen3 model, with task-intent inference and utility reported per task family against direct consultation, sensitive-value removal, and decoy baselines; no device hardware or latency is measured.
papers.evidence_zh: 因 HTML 版本不完整而阅读 PDF；本地 SLM 的角色由 GPT-4o-mini、DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和一个 Qwen3 模型扮演，按任务族报告任务意图推断与效用，对比直接咨询、去除敏感值和诱饵基线；没有设备硬件或延迟测量。
papers.code_status: not located in checked paper pages

papers.name: Hybrid MAS
papers.title: When Cloud Agents Meet Device Agents: Lessons from Hybrid Multi-Agent Systems
papers.summary: Adapts two multi-agent architectures to hybrid inference, a cloud supervisor that plans, verifies, and replans for an on-device executor (PEVR) and an execute-then-verify variant (EVA), and maps how backbone choice and supervision frequency shift accuracy, API cost, and estimated edge energy.
papers.summary_zh: 把两种多 agent 架构改造成端云混合推理：云端监督者为端侧执行者做规划、验证与重规划（PEVR），以及先执行后验证的变体（EVA）；系统测量骨干模型与监督频率如何影响准确率、API 成本和估算的端侧能耗。
papers.exchange: User query and execution state for verification / plans, verification verdicts, reset-safe summaries, and advice
papers.exchange_zh: 用户查询与供验证的执行状态 / 计划、验证结论、可安全重置的摘要与建议
papers.evidence: HotpotQA (500 validation questions), FanOutQA, and AppWorld with Qwen3 4B–32B as edge models and GPT-4o via Azure OpenAI as the cloud model; edge energy comes from an analytical model that the authors present as a lower bound for order-of-magnitude comparison, not a device measurement.
papers.evidence_zh: 在 HotpotQA（500 个验证集问题）、FanOutQA 和 AppWorld 上评测，端侧模型为 Qwen3 4B–32B，云端模型为通过 Azure OpenAI 调用的 GPT-4o；端侧能耗来自解析模型，作者说明它是用于数量级比较的下界，并非设备实测。
papers.code_status: not located in checked paper pages

papers.name: Division-of-Thoughts
papers.title: Division-of-Thoughts: Harnessing Hybrid Language Model Synergy for Efficient On-Device Agents
papers.summary: Decomposes a user query into sub-tasks, builds a dependency graph for parallel reasoning, and uses a plug-in adapter head on the SLM, trained from execution feedback, to assign each sub-task to the local SLM or the cloud LLM.
papers.summary_zh: 把用户查询分解为子任务并构建依赖图以并行推理，用 SLM 上一个由执行反馈训练的插件式适配头决定每个子任务交给本地 SLM 还是云端 LLM。
papers.exchange: Sub-tasks assigned to the cloud, with their dependencies / sub-task answers
papers.exchange_zh: 分配给云端的子任务及其依赖 / 子任务答案
papers.evidence: 200 test questions from each of seven benchmarks (P3, SCAN, MATH, CHAMP, DROP, CSQA, WebShop); GPT-4o is the cloud LLM and Llama 3-8B the on-device model, deployed on a local A100 GPU; reports accuracy, time cost, and API cost.
papers.evidence_zh: 在七个基准（P3、SCAN、MATH、CHAMP、DROP、CSQA、WebShop）上各取 200 道测试题；云端 LLM 为 GPT-4o，端侧模型为部署在本地 A100 GPU 上的 Llama 3-8B；报告准确率、时间成本与 API 成本。
papers.code_status: author-linked

papers.name: CoMIC
papers.title: CoMIC: Collaborative Memory and Insights Circulation for Long-Horizon LLM Agents in Web Cloud-Edge Systems
papers.summary: Lets edge web agents act locally with subgoal-oriented hierarchical memory while a cloud LLM critic asynchronously evaluates uploaded subgoal trajectories, admits reusable experience, and circulates guidance indexed by canonical subgoal identifiers back to all edge agents, without updating any model.
papers.summary_zh: 端侧 Web agent 借助以子目标为单位的分层记忆在本地执行；云端 LLM 评审异步评估上传的子目标轨迹、筛选可复用经验，并按规范化子目标标识把指导分发回所有端侧 agent，全程不更新模型参数。
papers.exchange: Subgoal trajectories with contextual features / admitted experience and cross-agent guidance keyed by subgoal identifiers
papers.exchange_zh: 带上下文特征的子目标轨迹 / 筛选后的经验与按子目标标识索引的跨 agent 指导
papers.evidence: Five AgentBoard tasks (Jericho, Blocksworld, Gripper, Tyreworld, Barman); edge agents run on a Linux workstation with one RTX 4090 and reach the cloud over HTTP/WebSocket; deepseek-chat is the cloud critic, with Mistral-7B edge agents alone or mixed with a gpt-4-turbo agent; here the edge is a Web edge server rather than a user device.
papers.evidence_zh: 在五个 AgentBoard 任务（Jericho、Blocksworld、Gripper、Tyreworld、Barman）上评测；端侧 agent 跑在配一张 RTX 4090 的 Linux 工作站上，通过 HTTP/WebSocket 与云端通信；云端评审为 deepseek-chat，端侧为单独的 Mistral-7B agent 或与一个 gpt-4-turbo agent 混合；这里的端侧是 Web 边缘服务器而非用户设备。
papers.code_status: not located in checked paper pages

papers.name: MCCom
papers.title: Balancing Latency and Accuracy of Code Completion via Local-Cloud Model Cascading
papers.summary: Cascades a local small code model with a cloud LLM for line-level completion: the small model drafts with speculative decoding, a rejected suggestion triggers the cloud model, and the rejected candidate re-ranks retrieved snippets before the cloud stage.
papers.summary_zh: 把本地小代码模型与云端 LLM 级联用于行级补全：小模型先用推测解码生成候选，建议被拒绝后才调用云端模型，被拒的候选还用来在云端阶段前重排检索到的代码片段。
papers.exchange: Code context and re-ranked retrieved snippets after a rejected local suggestion / cloud completion
papers.exchange_zh: 本地建议被拒后的代码上下文与重排后的检索片段 / 云端补全结果
papers.evidence: RepoEval line- and API-level subsets plus a new StmtEval benchmark, with 7B code LLMs such as Qwen2.5-Coder-7B as the cloud model and a trained 121M local model; offline experiments on A800 GPUs that account for retrieval, model inference, and an assumed 200 ms cloud query latency.
papers.evidence_zh: 在 RepoEval 的行级、API 级子集和新的 StmtEval 基准上评测，云端模型为 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 等 7B 代码模型，本地为训练的 1.21 亿参数模型；离线实验在 A800 GPU 上进行，计入检索、模型推理和假定的 200 ms 云端查询延迟。
papers.code_status: author-linked

papers.name: CAMP
papers.title: Contextual Augmented Multi-Model Programming (CAMP): A Hybrid Local-Cloud Copilot Framework
papers.summary: A local retrieval module in the IDE dynamically indexes code symbols and assembles context-aware prompts for a cloud LLM, implemented as the Copilot for Xcode plugin inside Xcode's sandbox.
papers.summary_zh: IDE 内的本地检索模块动态索引代码符号，为云端 LLM 组装带上下文的提示；实现为 Xcode 沙箱内的 Copilot for Xcode 插件。
papers.exchange: Prompts enriched with locally retrieved code context / completions, documentation, error warnings, and chat answers
papers.exchange_zh: 附带本地检索代码上下文的提示 / 补全、文档、错误提示与对话回答
papers.evidence: CoderEval class-, file-, and project-runnable tasks measured by Pass@K, plus a user study of the Xcode plugin; the local component is retrieval and indexing rather than a local generative model, and no device latency measurement is reported in the checked sections.
papers.evidence_zh: 在 CoderEval 的类级、文件级和项目级可运行任务上以 Pass@K 评测，另有 Xcode 插件的用户研究；本地组件是检索与索引而不是本地生成模型，所查章节未报告设备延迟测量。
papers.code_status: author-linked

papers.name: CloudEdgeVLA
papers.title: Latency-Tolerant Cloud-Edge Collaborative Vision-Language-Action Models via Emergent Representational Specialization
papers.summary: Splits a VLA policy so that a cloud VLA encodes possibly delayed observations into slowly varying task features while a lightweight edge head fuses the latest received feature with current local vision; training pairs fresh and randomly delayed frames with the same action target, and the robot never blocks on the cloud.
papers.summary_zh: 把 VLA 策略拆开：云端 VLA 把可能延迟的观测编码成变化缓慢的任务特征，端侧轻量动作头把最近收到的特征与当前本地视觉融合；训练时用新鲜帧与随机延迟帧配对同一动作目标，机器人从不阻塞等待云端。
papers.exchange: Observations sent asynchronously / cloud task features rather than actions

papers.name: SpecAgent
papers.title: Trajectory-Level Speculation with Semantic Verification for Tool-Using Agents
papers.summary: A weak model drafts agent steps while executing read-only tool calls and pauses at the first state-changing action; the strong model reviews the drafted segment in one prefill pass, commits the longest prefix it judges semantically valid, and repairs the first rejected step, so it mostly decodes short verdicts instead of every step.
papers.summary_zh: 弱模型起草 agent 步骤，起草时直接执行只读工具调用，遇到第一个会改变环境状态的动作就暂停；强模型用一次 prefill 审阅这段草稿，提交其判为语义有效的最长前缀并修复第一个被拒的步骤，因此强模型主要只解码简短的判定，而不是每一步。
papers.exchange: Drafted trajectory segment with real read-only tool observations and a held state-changing action / verdict (accepted prefix length, reason, optional replacement step) or a repair turn
papers.exchange_zh: 带真实只读工具观测、末尾挂起一个状态修改动作的轨迹草稿片段 / 判定（接受的前缀长度、理由、可选的替换步骤）或一轮修复
papers.evidence: Main experiments (τ²-Bench, AutomationBench, VitaBench) run both Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on H20 servers, with memory traffic and FLOPs estimated from token counts; the edge–cloud setting is a separate MCP-Atlas run with the weak model on one local RTX 5090 and three cloud API strong models, where API cost and strong output tokens fall but wall time does not.
papers.evidence_zh: 主实验（τ²-Bench、AutomationBench、VitaBench）中 Qwen3.5-4B 与 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 都部署在 H20 服务器上，显存流量和 FLOPs 由 token 数估算；端云设置是单独的 MCP-Atlas 实验，弱模型跑在一张本地 RTX 5090 上，强模型为三个云端 API 模型，API 费用和强模型输出 token 下降，但端到端时间没有下降。

papers.name: TP-JSCC
papers.title: TP-JSCC: Efficient Token Pruning and Joint Source-Channel Coding for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration
papers.summary: An embodied agent prunes multi-view visual tokens with segmentation-guided local and global semantic selection, then compresses the kept tokens with an SNR-conditioned MLP joint source-channel coder so they survive a noisy wireless link; the cloud decodes them and runs the LVLM for 3D visual question answering, while the question text goes over a reliable channel.
papers.summary_zh: 具身智能体先用分割先验引导、兼顾局部与全局语义的方式剪枝多视角视觉 token，再用以 SNR 为条件的 MLP 联合信源信道编码压缩保留的 token，使其能经受噪声无线链路；云端解码后运行 LVLM 完成 3D 视觉问答，问题文本经可靠信道传输。
papers.exchange: Question text over a reliable channel plus JSCC-encoded pruned visual tokens over a noisy channel / answer
papers.exchange_zh: 经可靠信道传输的问题文本，加上经噪声信道传输、JSCC 编码后的剪枝视觉 token / 答案
papers.evidence: ScanQA and SQA3D with cdViews view selection and LLaVA-OneVision as the cloud LVLM; the wireless link is a simulated AWGN channel at 0–25 dB SNR, and edge-side cost is reported as GFLOPs (stated to fit a Jetson TX2-class GPU) rather than measured on a device.
papers.evidence_zh: 在 ScanQA 与 SQA3D 上评测，使用 cdViews 选视角、LLaVA-OneVision 作为云端 LVLM；无线链路为 0–25 dB SNR 的仿真 AWGN 信道，端侧开销以 GFLOPs 报告（文中称可由 Jetson TX2 级 GPU 承担），未在真实设备上测量。

papers.name: Label-Budgeted Attribute Inference
papers.title: Label-Budgeted Attribute Inference from Protected Features in Edge-Cloud Split Multimodal LLMs
papers.summary: Measures how much an honest-but-curious server can infer age, gender, and race from the intermediate features it receives in device–server split MLLM inference, using recovery curves over the attacker's budget of labeled protected samples plus a classifier-free dependence test, and finds that leakage persists across split depths and under input-, decoder-, and embedding-level protections.
papers.summary_zh: 在设备—服务器拆分推理的多模态大模型中，测量诚实但好奇的服务器能从收到的中间特征推断出多少年龄、性别和种族信息：用随攻击者带标签受保护样本预算变化的恢复曲线，加上不依赖分类器的依赖性检验；结论是泄露在各拆分深度都存在，在输入、解码器和嵌入层面的保护下也仍可恢复。
papers.exchange: Hidden-state sequence after the split layer (generation) or a 512-dimensional embedding (face verification) / server-side output
papers.exchange_zh: 拆分层之后的隐状态序列（生成任务）或 512 维嵌入（人脸验证） / 服务器端输出
papers.evidence: LLaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-3B on FairFace and UTKFace, with an RTX 2080 Ti (11 GiB) emulating the device and a V100 as the server; device latency, memory, and energy are measured per split layer, while transmission time is computed for an assumed link rate.
papers.evidence_zh: 在 FairFace 与 UTKFace 上评测 LLaVA-1.5-7B 和 Qwen2.5-VL-3B，以 RTX 2080 Ti（11 GiB）模拟设备、V100 作为服务器；按拆分层测量设备端延迟、显存和能耗，传输时间按假定链路速率计算。
